Vada pav, alternatively spelt wada pao, (listenⓘ) is a vegetarian fast food dish native to the Indian state of Maharashtra.[1] The dish consists of a deep-fried potato dumpling placed inside a bread bun (pav) sliced almost in half through the middle.

It is generally accompanied by one or more chutneys and a green chili pepper.[2] Although it originated as an inexpensive street food in Mumbai, it is now served in food stalls and restaurants across India.

It is also called Bombay burger[3] in keeping with its origins and its resemblance in physical form to a burger.
